crossRefs.note: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him;
even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—
and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,
that I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his…
if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.
He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also…
Yet I had planted you a noble vine, a pure and faithful seed. How then have you turned into the degenerate branches of…
But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.
Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it…
“I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

translations.web: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;
translations.bsb: For if we have been united with Him like this in His death, we will certainly also be united with Him in His resurrection.
translations.kjv: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:
translations.asv: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection;
